whoItsFor: Developers and teams using Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode, or similar agent harnesses who want a prebuilt set of agents, skills, hooks, rules, and memory to improve agent workflows.
useCases: Add planning, TDD, and code-review workflows to Claude Code or Codex sessions
Scan agent configs, hooks, MCP settings, and secrets with AgentShield
Persist session context and learned instincts across coding sessions

requirements.runtime: Node.js 18 or newer; Git and Claude Code 2.1 or newer on PATH for Claude plugin setup
